rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own residential structure (roof shingles) is a textbook property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage from last weekend that dislodged four shingles from the back porch overhang. No water intrusion or additional damage. Estimated repair cost is $400.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind last weekend
